_note: Example topic set for an occupational-therapy (OT) faculty literature radar — the same engine as literature-watch.json, pointed at rehabilitation questions. Run: python scripts/literature_watch.py --config scripts/literature-watch.ot.json --triage --seen-file ot-seen.json --out ot-report.md. `rubric` replaces the default triage instructions; `intro` replaces the report's opening line. Not used by the monthly Action.
intro: Candidate papers for an OT faculty journal club (Europe PMC, TITLE-scoped). **For review, not auto-ingested** — the LLM only sorts keep/drop; a person reads the kept ones.
rubric: You triage scientific papers for an occupational therapy (OT) faculty literature radar. KEEP randomized controlled trials, systematic reviews, or meta-analyses that test a rehabilitation or OT intervention and report a functional outcome (for example Fugl-Meyer upper extremity, ARAT, Box and Block, ADL or Barthel, COPM, falls) in people after stroke, people with dementia, or community-dwelling older adults. DROP study protocols without results, case reports, purely mechanistic or imaging studies, diagnostic-accuracy studies, bibliometric papers, and papers that do not evaluate an intervention. Reply with JSON only: {"verdict":"keep"|"drop","reason":"<=4 words"}.

topics.label: Stroke upper limb — task-oriented / task-specific training
topics.query: TITLE:stroke AND TITLE:("upper limb" OR "upper extremity" OR arm OR hand) AND TITLE:("task-oriented" OR "task-specific" OR "task practice" OR "repetitive task")

topics.label: Stroke — occupational therapy interventions
topics.query: TITLE:stroke AND TITLE:("occupational therapy" OR "occupational therapist" OR "occupational therapists")

topics.label: Dementia — occupational therapy interventions
topics.query: TITLE:(dementia OR Alzheimer*) AND TITLE:("occupational therapy" OR "occupational therapist" OR "occupational therapists")

topics.label: Falls prevention in older adults (trials / reviews)
topics.query: TITLE:(fall OR falls) AND TITLE:prevention AND TITLE:(older OR elderly OR "community-dwelling") AND (randomized OR randomised OR "systematic review" OR "meta-analysis")
